query:
SELECT j.id, j.description, j.status, j.competenceMonth,
  ae.entryType, ae.amount, ca.code as accountCode, ca.name as accountName
FROM journals j
LEFT JOIN accountingEntries ae ON ae.journalId = j.id
LEFT JOIN chartOfAccounts ca ON ae.accountId = ca.id
WHERE j.competenceMonth = '2026-01'
  AND (j.description LIKE '%Outra Receita%' OR j.description LIKE '%Outras Receitas%')
ORDER BY j.id, ae.entryType
